verdict.rationale: Aider supports natural-language troubleshooting: `/ask` answers questions about the codebase without editing files, `/run` and `/test` feed program output and test errors back to the model, auto-lint and auto-test run after each edit, and `AI?` comments or voice requests can ask questions or ask for bug fixes. Community users confirm it answers code-location questions and helps them understand unfamiliar codebases faster than grep or search. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party debugging workflow doc (e.g., stack-trace or error-diagnosis guidance), and independent hands-on reports of debugging specifically rather than general code comprehension.
